HasUponPickupEffect.rationale: Matches PotionBelt.cs:15, and it is load-bearing here in a way it is not for the batch's Ancient relics: Potion Belt is COMMON, so without this flag Relic.is_tradable would return True and a spent Potion Belt would be offerable to the trade events. The flag is the only thing stopping that, and the port has it.

AfterObtained.maps_to: no counterpart. `Relic.after_obtained(run)` exists (relics/base.py:138-141) and RunState.add_relic dispatches it (run.py:552); potion_belt.py implements nothing
AfterObtained.issue:
SCOPE RULING (2026-07-26 relic fix pass, applied at every potion site in this tier). The shared contract's 'Out of scope everywhere: potions (deferred by Perry)' means POTION IS NOT AN AUDITED KIND -- there is no `potion` roster kind and no `audit/records/potion/`. It does NOT mean that potion-affecting behaviour of an AUDITED relic is invisible. The relic tier itself already reads it that way at the overwhelming majority of its sites: 45 relic gap entries across 25 records turn on potion mechanics, 27 of them tagged LIVE (relic/belt_buckle, relic/cauldron, relic/sozu, relic/delicate_frond, relic/petrified_toad, relic/tiny_mailbox, relic/white_beast_statue, relic/wongos_mystery_ticket, relic/phial_holster G1 ...), against only four records that waived on the exclusion. Binding rule 3 forces one answer and the majority is also the better-reasoned side: potions ARE ported (51 registered classes, 48 in the reward pool) and the belt is conformance-asserted -- sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:623-631 diffs `floor_potions` slot by slot and sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:715-717 reads `max_potions`. A divergence the conformance runner asserts on is by definition one a replay sees, which is the README's definition of a gap.
AT THIS SITE (LIVE, grade B): PotionBelt.cs:19-22 is a single `PlayerCmd.GainMaxPotionCount(DynamicVars['PotionSlots'].IntValue, Owner)` with PotionSlots = 2 (PotionBelt.cs:17, no AscensionHelper branch in the file), so the game's belt grows 3 -> 5. The port has no `after_obtained` at all. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b12.py b12-potionbelt`): `relic=potion_belt  max_potions 3 -> 3`, against `phial_holster 3 -> 4` and `alchemical_coffer 3 -> 7`, both of which call the helper this relic needs. LIVE and cheap to reach: Potion Belt is COMMON and sits in the transcribed shared grab bag (`b12-pool` reports bag=Common), so any combat or elite reward can hand it over. The observable is the belt itself -- two slots the player never gets -- and `sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:715-717` reads `max_potions` while `runner.py:623-631` diffs the slots. Rollup of guard N1 per binding rule 4. Re-verdicted from waiver; see guard N2 for the fix recipe.

guards.what: N2: the fix recipe for N1, and the EXECUTED NEGATIVE that the two missing slots cannot reach a combat number by any ported chain
guards.rationale: Re-verdicted from waiver by the 2026-07-26 fix pass along with N1; this entry describes no divergence of its own, so it carries no verdict weight -- N1 and AfterObtained own the gap. Kept because both halves are still wanted. (a) THE FIX: `def after_obtained(self, run): run.add_potion_slots(self.POTION_SLOTS)` with POTION_SLOTS = 2 from `DynamicVar('PotionSlots', 2m)` (PotionBelt.cs:17) -- the pinned non-ascension value, no `AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension` anywhere in the file. It does NOT also need an `undo_after_obtained`: per PROMPT.md v6 item 3 the absence of that helper is faithful at every site because nothing in the game un-picks a relic; the conformance runner's relic swap (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:455-461) leaking two slots is a TOOLING defect to fix in the runner, and the mango/pear family shows what happens when an undo is written to clamp instead of subtract (see relic/pear). (b) THE EXECUTED NEGATIVE (binding rule 5): belt capacity decides whether a procure SUCCEEDS, since both `Player.AddPotionInternal` and `RunState.add_potion` (sts2_rl/run.py:474-485) fail silently on a full belt, and relic/belt_buckle's Dexterity turns on whether the belt is EMPTY -- but not on whether it is full, so a missing slot cannot change Belt Buckle's 2 Dexterity by itself. I could not construct a ported chain from the missing slots to a combat number and none is claimed; the nearest exposure is that a full belt drops relic/petrified_toad's per-combat rock, which changes the belt and nothing else. That is why the gap is graded B (state divergence, belt only) and not A. Rule 7: sts2_rl/relics/base.py, sts2_rl/run.py, sts2_rl/player.py, audit/records/relic/belt_buckle.json and audit/records/relic/petrified_toad.json are cited and not hashed here.
